t2.thesis: PLTR will likely beat and raise again, but a demanding valuation and a sell-off-hit tape make the overnight reaction close to a coin flip, slightly below the buy-everything base rate.
reasons: Base rate for software/AMC events is about 0.54, and PLTR's last 4 prints went 2 up, 2 down, despite every one being a large EPS beat.
Q2 had 93% growth, 149% US commercial growth and a FY raise, so the next beat and raise is likely, but consensus (~84% growth, about $2.17B) already sits slightly above the top of the $2.164B guide.
The valuation leaves little room for error (78x forward P/E, 72x sales), and commentary (I10) says the guide has to do more than beat.
The stock is down about 6% over 5 days and 12% off its 52-week high, with a tech/capex sell-off (I6, I12), which lowers positioning risk somewhat.
The 13.4% implied move with IV/RV of about 2.3 shows options are pricing a large two-way event; skew is roughly neutral and the put/call ratio is about 0.84.
t2.deciding_variable: The size of the FY2026 revenue and US commercial guidance raise (and any first FY2027 commentary) versus elevated buy-side whisper numbers.

prior.from: I3 software_internet cluster t0_hit 0.541 (AMC session 0.538; overall ~0.54)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report (2026-11-02) is still a few days in the future as of today (2026-10-30), so the stock's reaction hasn't happened yet.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 1 point: the high bar from valuation and a consensus already above the guide, plus a 50% beat-to-rise record, slightly outweigh the pre-print pullback and the JPM initiation.

theses.mechanism: Q3 revenue lands well above $2.2B, with US commercial growth of 140% or more and a FY raise to about 85% or more, extending the August pattern.
theses.wrong_if: The beat is merely in line with the usual guide-beat cadence and the stock sells the news, as it did in Nov 2025 and May 2026.

theses.mechanism: A solid beat that falls short of elevated whispers, with sequential US commercial deceleration or weaker TCV, triggers multiple compression at 70x+ sales amid a tech capex sell-off.
theses.wrong_if: The guidance raise is large enough to reset 2027 numbers materially higher.

theses.mechanism: Results roughly match whispers, and the pre-print pullback already absorbed the macro tech weakness.
theses.wrong_if: Realized move exceeds about 7% in either direction, which is likely given a 13% implied move.

key_observations: Q3 revenue versus the $2.164B guide top and the ~$2.17B consensus
US commercial revenue growth year over year and quarter over quarter (Q2 was 149% / 28%)
Size of the FY2026 revenue and US commercial guidance raise; Q4 guide implied growth
US commercial TCV and RDV trends
